series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: Through 2020, 80 percent of AI projects will remain alchemy, run by wizards whose talents won’t scale widely in the organization.
entries.subject: AI project delivery
entries.metric: share of AI projects remaining alchemy

entries.quote: By 2023, there will be an 80 percent reduction in missing people in mature markets compared with 2018 due to AI face recognition.
entries.subject: AI face recognition and missing people
entries.metric: reduction in missing people in mature markets vs 2018

entries.quote: By 2023, U.S. emergency department visits will be reduced by 20 million due to enrollment of chronically ill patients in AI-enhanced virtual care.
entries.subject: AI-enhanced virtual care
entries.metric: reduction in U.S. emergency department visits

entries.quote: By 2023, 25 percent of organizations will require employees to sign an affidavit to avoid cyberbullying, but 70 percent of these initiatives will fail.
entries.subject: Cyberbullying affidavits
entries.metric: share of organizations requiring employee anti-cyberbullying affidavits
entries.note: Also: 70% of these initiatives will fail.

entries.quote: Through 2022, 75 percent of organizations with frontline decision-making teams reflecting diversity and an inclusive culture will exceed their financial targets.
entries.subject: Diversity and financial performance
entries.metric: share of diverse, inclusive frontline decision-making organizations exceeding financial targets

entries.quote: By 2021, 75 percent of public blockchains will suffer “privacy poisoning” — inserted personal data that renders the blockchain noncompliant with privacy laws.
entries.subject: Blockchain privacy poisoning
entries.metric: share of public blockchains suffering privacy poisoning

entries.quote: By 2023, ePrivacy regulations will increase online costs by minimizing the use of “cookies” thus crippling the current internet ad revenue machine.
entries.subject: ePrivacy regulation and cookies

entries.quote: Through 2022, a fast path to digital will be converting internal capabilities to external revenue-generating products using cloud economics and flexibility.
entries.subject: Productizing internal capabilities

entries.quote: By 2022, companies leveraging the “gatekeeper” position of the digital giants will capture 40 percent global market share, on average, in their industry.
entries.subject: Digital giant gatekeepers
entries.metric: average industry market share captured by companies leveraging digital giants

entries.quote: Through 2021, social media scandals and security breaches will have effectively zero lasting consumer impact.
entries.subject: Consumer impact of social media scandals
entries.note: Claim of effectively zero lasting consumer impact.

notes: Edition covers '2019 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: 10 (press release: 'top 10 strategic predictions'). Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
